intent: Represent post-consent runtime availability truthfully across full, degraded and integrity-blocked states without weakening ACTIVE or manufacturing host capability.
principles: DEGRADED is non-ACTIVE and cannot use iKant identity as if ACTIVE
DEGRADED is allowed only for observed availability/capability loss, never to mask integrity, consent or source contradictions
runtime-like means lifecycle/status/help can continue with an explicit loss-of-guarantee card; it does not imply repository runtime execution
business status must state what is verified, what is not guaranteed and the concrete recovery dependency
ACTIVE remains the conjunction of all source, transfer, materialization, live-host, persistence and commit gates
turn release remains separately fail-closed when required artifact presentation is unavailable
deadline unavailable/invalid/elapsed-unavailable/exceeded are distinct results; only a proven elapsed above the ceiling is DEADLINE_EXCEEDED
sticky deadline terminals require a fresh admission and cannot be crossed by manual recovery

session_states.ORIENTING: source orientation in progress; no consent yet
session_states.AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE: current Terms presented and frozen; exact human acceptance pending
session_states.ACTIVATING: valid acceptance observed; required activation gates still unresolved
session_states.DEGRADED: non-ACTIVE recoverable availability state with explicit missing guarantees and recovery dependency
session_states.BLOCKED_INTEGRITY: source, consent or evidence contradiction; no degraded fallback is permitted
session_states.ACTIVE: all mandatory activation gates passed and ACTIVE commit persisted/read back
session_states.SESSION_NONCONFORMING: non-retroactive session breach; fresh conforming chat required
session_states.EXITED: human exact exit completed for an ACTIVE epoch
session_states.ADMISSION_EPOCH_UNRECOVERABLE: single-shot admission cannot be recovered in place because deadline origin/elapsed is unavailable, invalid or exceeded; fresh admission required

turn_states.PROCESSING: ACTIVE turn entered runtime and has not completed release
turn_states.RELEASE_BLOCKED: runtime work may exist but required same-turn artifact presentation is not proven; Surface A must not be released as conforming
turn_states.RELEASED: required artifact presentation and Surface A release completed in order

degraded_codes.EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE: required source-bound bootstrap evidence is absent rather than contradictory
degraded_codes.BYTE_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE: no observed byte-exact carrier-to-local-filesystem path with readback
degraded_codes.LOCAL_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE: runtime bytes are identified but local materialization/reopen is unavailable
degraded_codes.HOST_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: one or more mandatory live host capabilities are unavailable
degraded_codes.ACTIVE_COMMIT_UNAVAILABLE: all prior gates may be satisfied but ACTIVE persistence/readback did not complete

global_dod.pass_condition: every intermediate DoD passes on exact candidate bytes; zero unsafe ACTIVE, zero integrity-to-DEGRADED laundering, zero incomplete DEGRADED business cards, zero blocking mutation survivors

local_dods.test: one immutable source head owns orientation and runtime identity
current Terms plus later exact standalone I ACCEPT; no embedded/prior acceptance
all delivered objects match exact content-addressed identities; model-mediated reconstruction forbidden
a carrier-to-local path is observed with byte readback before it can satisfy runtime delivery
authoritative materializer verifies members, atomic publish and reopen
real Node 20+, filesystem, SHA-256, clock and artifact sink evidence
single writer persistence and readback before reliance
ACTIVE only after all upstream evidence and persisted/readback commit
monotonic I ACCEPT to ACTIVE ceiling cannot be reset by retry
required Surface B artifact is presented before conforming Surface A release
ACTIVE, DEGRADED, BLOCKED_INTEGRITY and SESSION_NONCONFORMING are mutually exclusive truth states
every DEGRADED result names missing guarantee, preserved evidence and recovery dependency in business-readable bounded text
recovery instructions name a concrete missing capability and never claim recovery already occurred
10,000,000 deterministic semantic mutation cases across all state and failure families
1,000,000 independent deterministic qualification mutations on the final candidate
removing any retained global semantic node reopens at least one false classification or false-green case
